description: This file defines the AppState class which manages the application's global state, configuration, and persistence in a macOS environment. It handles user preferences, remote gateway configuration, voice wake features, and configuration watchers, providing methods for state updates and synchronization with external services.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A final class managing the overall application state, user preferences, gateway configurations, and voice features, with initializations, state updates, and configuration synchronization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AppState, loads preferences, sets up configuration, and starts watching configuration files.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the configuration watcher when the AppState is deallocated.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads and applies configuration from disk.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Overrides current configuration based on loaded configuration dictionary.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes the configuration with the external gateway immediately.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality, requesting permissions if needed.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, with permission checks and external service calls.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Temporarily activates voice ears for a specified TTL.
